description: Kyojin: open-source engine that runs the largest open models on one mini PC or one graphics card, about 2× faster than llama.cpp. AMD (ROCm) and NVIDIA (CUDA), built on ExLlamaV3.
summary: Kyojin: the Yamz inference engine for AMD Strix Halo (ROCm, gfx1151), built on ExLlamaV3. Runs 300B-class MoE models on one 128 GB mini PC.
